purpose: Same data as pvm-01 with the interaction term reported separately.
convention: Price at base quantity = (p1-p0) x q0; interaction = (p1-p0) x (q1-q0) reported separately; volume and mix at base prices.
derivation: Price at base q = 2 x 100 = 200. Interaction = 2 x (-10) = -20. Volume = -100. Mix = 0. 200 - 20 - 100 = 80.
edge_case_expectation: The two conventions give different price effects (180 vs 200) but both reconcile to 80; the convention must be declared in output.
